title: Reproducible analysis code for rigorous reassessment of a public-data colorectal cancer transcriptomic survival algorithm
description: Analysis code, validation tests, compact certified result tables, figure files, and environment records for a public-data study of optimism, feature-selection stability, cross-cohort transportability, and probe-mapping sensitivity in a colorectal cancer transcriptomic survival algorithm. This release does not provide a clinically deployable prediction model.
